cards.card_text: Job ends by asking about going down to the gates of Sheol and into the dust.
cards.verse_text: Will it go down to the gates of Sheol? Will we go down together into the dust?”

cards.card_text: He starts with what he said back when it looked like the end: in the prime of his life, he'd go through the gates of Sheol.
cards.verse_text: This is a writing by Hezekiah king of Judah after his illness and recovery: I said, “In the prime of my life I must go through the gates of Sheol and be deprived of the remainder of my years.”
